chunks: And from a letter of his (peace be upon him) to Kumayl ibn Ziyad an-Nakha'i, while he was his governor in Hit,
he expresses his displeasure with his failure to prevent those from the enemy army who passed through his area, seeking to raid.
ai.seo_question: What criticism did Imam Ali raise against Kumayl ibn Ziyad regarding his governance in Hit?
ai.summary: This letter, a cornerstone of Shia political ethics, critiques Governor Kumayl ibn Ziyad for passive negligence in defending the frontier city of Hit against enemy incursions. It underscores the Imam’s emphasis on proactive military vigilance and the ruler’s personal accountability for the security of his domain, reflecting the strategic challenges of the early Islamic period.

en.sayed-ali-raza: To Kumayl ibn Ziyād an-Nakha‘ī, the Governor of Hit
expressing displeasure on his inability to prevent the the enemy forces that passed through his area from marauding.
